Subject: Vendor settlement schedule change request

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick setup call last week. One item that came up internally: our standard preferred settlement is Net 30, but we understand Redwood defaults to Net 45 for new vendors. FastSoft has a short cash runway in Q2 and we'd like to request Net 30 (or enrollment in any early-pay program) for the first 60 days while we scale.

I attached our completed VendorSetupForm.xlsx and our W-9. We can also provide bank remit details once you confirm next steps.

If enrollment in an early-pay program is required, what are the fees/discounts and who at Redwood handles enrollment? We can be flexible on a small fee if it speeds payment.

Thanks —
Ami Patel
Head of Partnerships, FastSoft, Inc.
ami@fastsoft.com | +1 (408) 555-0176

Attachments: W-9.pdf, VendorSetupForm.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor settlement schedule change request

Hi Ami —

Appreciate the attachments and the context. High level: Redwood's standard onboarding payment term is Net 45. We can evaluate a short-term Net 30 or early-pay option for initial invoices, but that needs approval from Finance and a quick enrollment in our early-pay portal.

Ben — looping you in to confirm our early-pay fee schedule and enrollment flow. Marissa — FYI from an account perspective; you may want to note the ask in the onboarding checklist.

Ami, two quick asks to speed this up:
- Can you send BankRemit.pdf (ACH details) and a copy of the vendor contact for invoice submission?
- Do you have a PO expectation (e.g., will Redwood issue a PO per invoice or a blanket PO)?

If Finance signs off on a 2% early-pay fee, we can target Net 10/Net 30 settlement on the pilot invoices. Otherwise we will default to Net 45. I can escalate if we need an SLA exception.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Hi all —

Quick finance note: our early-pay pilot offers up to 2% discount for payment within 10 business days. Enrollment requires: completed vendor banking form (BankRemit.pdf), signed vendor agreement, and invoice submission via our AP portal (we accept emailed PDF invoices to ap@redwood.com for onboarding, then we ask vendors to use the portal).

For one-off exceptions (Net 30 for first 60 days) I can authorize a temporary override if Marissa confirms the account spend profile and PO process. If FastSoft can accept the 2% discount, the enrollment and payment timing is faster because we can route the invoices to the early-pay queue — typical turnaround 7–10 days after approval.

DocuSign envelope for the enrollment + vendor agreement is here: https://redwood-mycompany.docusign.com/envelope/SAMPLE-ENROLL-12345

Next steps for Ami: please upload BankRemit.pdf and confirm the vendor's invoice email and desired PO process. Marissa, can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a blanket PO or per-invoice POs for this account?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Finance Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Ben/Kimberly —

Attached is BankRemit.pdf and the vendor's AP contact (invoices@fastsoft.com). We can accept a 2% early-pay discount for the first 60 days to accelerate cashflow. Please send the DocuSign link and any vendor agreement language that finance needs to review.
